characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: At the start of the battle, select one unit in your opponent’s army to be this model’s hated foe. Each time this model makes an attack that targets its hated foe, you can re-roll the Wound roll. Each time this model’s hated foe is destroyed, you can select a new unit from your opponent’s army to be its hated foe.
